title: The purple cover
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is a thumbprint. Purple, drawn gray, on cream. The owner says it's a smudge. Wood says it's a signature. She says whose. He says the mill's. She looks at it and says she can taste it. Everyone knows the mill's berries.

panels.composition: The cover: a single thumbprint on cream, gray, its ridges exact.
